milestones.title: Fix Test Output Artifacts
milestones.description: Eliminate unhandled error artifacts in test stderr output to improve CI/CD clarity and signal-to-noise ratio.

tasks.title: Fix useFormStack Test Error Output
tasks.description: Suppress 'uncaught error' artifacts in useFormStack.test.tsx by improving error catching pattern.

subtasks.title: Audit current error-throwing test patterns in useFormStack.test.tsx
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/system_context.md - Tests use Vitest with jsdom, current console.error suppression exists in beforeEach/afterEach.
2. INPUT: File path src/hooks/__tests__/useFormStack.test.tsx containing error boundary tests.
3. LOGIC: Review all tests that intentionally throw errors to verify they properly suppress console.error. Identify patterns where expect().toThrow() is used incorrectly vs testing error boundary results.
4. OUTPUT: List of test descriptions and line numbers where error suppression needs improvement, documented in plan_bugfix/architecture/test_audit_notes.md.

subtasks.title: Implement improved error suppression for useFormStack tests
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 1.2 - Use vi.fn() to spy on console.error, restore in afterEach. Don't use expect().toThrow() for error boundaries.
2. INPUT: Audit list from P1.M1.T1.S1 identifying specific test cases needing improvement.
3. LOGIC: For each identified test, ensure console.error is properly suppressed before the error is thrown and restored after assertion. Use the pattern: beforeEach(() => { console.error = vi.fn(); }); afterEach(() => { console.error = originalError; });. Test the RESULT (fallback UI), not the throw.
4. OUTPUT: Modified src/hooks/__tests__/useFormStack.test.tsx with no unhandled error artifacts in stderr when running npm test.

milestones.title: Fix URL Sync Race Condition
milestones.description: Implement race condition mitigation in useFormStackURLSync hook to prevent inconsistent state during rapid form open/close operations combined with browser back button navigation.

tasks.title: Design Race Condition Mitigation Strategy
tasks.description: Research and design the best approach to prevent race conditions in URL sync using modern React patterns.

subtasks.title: Analyze current URL sync implementation and race condition scenarios
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/system_context.md - useFormStackURLSync.ts uses isRestoringRef flag, prevStackRef for tracking, syncStackToUrl function at lines 226-247.
2. INPUT: File src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts containing the current URL synchronization logic.
3. LOGIC: Analyze the specific race condition described in PRD Issue 2: (1) User opens Form A → URL updates, (2) User quickly opens Form B → URL updates, (3) User hits back → popstate fires, (4) If URL sync effect hasn't run, prevStackRef might be stale. Document the exact sequence of events and the potential failure mode.
4. OUTPUT: Detailed race condition analysis in plan_bugfix/architecture/url_race_analysis.md with sequence diagrams and current mitigation gaps.

subtasks.title: Select optimal race condition mitigation pattern
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 2 - Three patterns available: (A) useRef for tracking pending operations, (B) useDeferredValue for non-blocking updates, (C) useTransition for coordinated updates. Section 2.2 recommends useRef pattern with pending update coalescing.
2. INPUT: Race condition analysis from P1.M2.T1.S1 identifying the exact failure scenario.
3. LOGIC: Evaluate the three patterns against the specific use case: rapid form open/close + browser back button. Consider: (1) Does useDeferredValue introduce unacceptable URL lag? (2) Does useTransition work with history API? (3) Can useRef pending update pattern prevent all race scenarios? Select the pattern that maintains URL sync accuracy while preventing race conditions.
4. OUTPUT: Decision document in plan_bugfix/architecture/url_mitigation_decision.md with selected pattern, justification, and implementation sketch.

tasks.title: Implement Race Condition Fix
tasks.description: Implement the selected race condition mitigation pattern in useFormStackURLSync hook.

subtasks.title: Implement useRef-based pending update tracking
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 2.2 - useRef pattern: isUpdatingRef flag tracks when URL updates are in progress, pendingUpdateRef stores latest state, updateURL function coalesces rapid updates.
2. INPUT: Decision from P1.M2.T1.S2 specifying useRef pattern (assume selected), file src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts.
3. LOGIC: Add isUpdatingRef and pendingUpdateRef to track async URL operations. Modify syncStackToUrl function to check isUpdatingRef.current and store pending updates instead of immediately calling history API. Add cleanup in useEffect to process pending updates after completion. Ensure popstate handler respects isUpdatingRef flag.
4. OUTPUT: Modified src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts with race condition protection, preserving all existing functionality.

subtasks.title: Add isMountedRef pattern for unmount safety
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 2.4 - isMountedRef pattern prevents updates after unmount, critical for rapidly closing forms.
2. INPUT: Modified src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts from P1.M2.T2.S1.
3. LOGIC: Add isMountedRef initialized to true, set to false in useEffect cleanup. Wrap all history API calls and state updates in `if (!isMountedRef.current) return;` guards. Prevents memory leaks and 'update after unmount' React warnings.
4. OUTPUT: Enhanced src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts with unmount protection.

subtasks.title: Write tests for race condition scenarios
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/system_context.md - Test pattern: renderHook for hooks, act() for state changes, mock window.history API.
2. INPUT: Modified src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts from P1.M2.T2.S2.
3. LOGIC: Write integration tests in src/hooks/__tests__/useFormStackURLSync.test.tsx covering: (1) Rapid openForm calls (3+ in quick succession), (2) Open form → immediate browser back, (3) Open → open → back → forward sequence, (4) Verify URL state remains consistent throughout, (5) Verify no history entries are duplicated. Use fake timers and mock history.pushState/replaceState.
4. OUTPUT: New test cases in useFormStackURLSync.test.tsx that verify race condition protection works correctly.

milestones.title: Improve Error Handling & API Clarity
milestones.description: Address silent failures in popToIndex, clarify public API usage, and document error retry behavior.

tasks.title: Fix popToIndex Silent Failure
tasks.description: Add development-mode error throwing for invalid popToIndex indices to aid debugging.

subtasks.title: Implement development-only error for invalid popToIndex
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/system_context.md - FormStackProvider.tsx lines 106-108 contain current silent return, code uses TypeScript strict mode, consumer Breadcrumbs component validates indices before calling.
2. INPUT: File src/components/FormStackProvider.tsx, specifically the popToIndex function around lines 106-108.
3. LOGIC: Add a conditional check: if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && (index < 0 || index >= state.stack.length)) { throw new RangeError(`popToIndex: Invalid index ${index}. Stack length is ${state.stack.length}.`); }. This throws in dev but silently fails in production (graceful degradation). Add JSDoc comment explaining this behavior.
4. OUTPUT: Modified src/components/FormStackProvider.tsx with dev-only error throwing for invalid indices.

subtasks.title: Add test for popToIndex error handling
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 1.4 - Test results, not throws. Use expect().toThrow() for synchronous function calls that should throw.
2. INPUT: Modified popToIndex function from P1.M3.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: In src/components/__tests__/FormStackProvider.test.tsx, add test cases: (1) 'should throw error in development for negative index', (2) 'should throw error in development for out-of-bounds index', (3) 'should return undefined silently in production for invalid index'. Mock NODE_ENV to 'development' and 'production'. Use expect(popToIndex(-1)).toThrow() pattern since this is a direct function call, not an error boundary.
4. OUTPUT: New tests in FormStackProvider.test.tsx verifying error throwing behavior.

tasks.title: Document Error Retry Limitations
tasks.description: Add documentation to FormErrorBoundary explaining that retry is for transient errors only.

subtasks.title: Add JSDoc and comment documentation for retry behavior
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/system_context.md - FormErrorBoundary.tsx lines 110-116 implement retry using retryCount to force remount, props remain unchanged on retry.
2. INPUT: File src/components/FormErrorBoundary.tsx, specifically handleRetry method and component JSDoc.

milestones.title: Performance Optimizations
milestones.description: Optimize callback creation in FormStackRenderer to prevent unnecessary re-renders in deeply nested form stacks.

tasks.title: Memoize FormStackRenderer Callbacks
tasks.description: Implement useCallback or useMemo for handleSubmit, handleCancel, and handleError to prevent creating new functions on every render.

subtasks.title: Analyze performance impact of current callback creation
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 3 - React 19 Compiler auto-memoizes, useCallback overhead is ~0.01ms, break-even is 100+ prevented re-renders. Forms are already isolated by CSS visibility.
2. INPUT: File src/components/FormStackRenderer.tsx lines 42-60 where callbacks are created in render loop.
3. LOGIC: Measure current performance: Create a test with 10 nested forms, modify top form state, count re-renders using React DevTools Profiler or console.log in components. Determine if hidden forms re-render when visible form changes. Assess if memoization would provide measurable benefit or premature optimization.
4. OUTPUT: Performance analysis in plan_bugfix/architecture/callback_performance_analysis.md with profiler data and recommendation.

subtasks.title: Implement callback memoization if beneficial
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan_bugfix/architecture/testing_best_practices.md Section 3.2 - useCallback is worthwhile when function is passed to memoized child or used as dependency. Section 3.6 decision tree.
2. INPUT: Performance analysis from P1.M4.T1.S1 (may recommend no action if benefit is negligible).
3. LOGIC: If analysis shows benefit: Wrap handleSubmit, handleCancel, handleError in useCallback with dependencies [entry.deferred, onClose, onCancelRequest]. Use entry.id as key to maintain stable references. If analysis shows no benefit: Document why memoization is unnecessary (CSS isolation already prevents visual updates, React 19 Compiler may optimize).
4. OUTPUT: Either (A) Modified src/components/FormStackRenderer.tsx with memoized callbacks OR (B) Documentation in plan_bugfix/architecture/callback_memoization_decision.md explaining why no change is needed.
